branded.why: One dairy's or company's product, sold in its shops but no part of a food culture beyond them.

about.text: A line of curd cheese snacks from the Lithuanian dairy Žemaitijos pienas, mostly coated in chocolate or glaze, in flavours such as vanilla, caramel and poppy seed.

sources.text: The curd base, the coatings and the flavours, from this page.
